review_candidates.title: Technical Office Manager
review_candidates.description: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Technical Office Manager to join our team in Alexandria . The ideal candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality technical documentation and supporting mechanical design processes with precision and innovation. This role offers an excellent opportunity for professional development within a leading steel manufacturing company in Egypt. Responsibilities: Lead and manage the Technical Office team, ensuring timely delivery of accurate and high-quality technical outputs. Oversee the preparation and review of technical documentation, including drawings, BOMs, calculation sheets, instruction manuals, and data sheets. Establish and control product coding and technical documentation standards for newly approved items. Supervise the mechanical design and development of new products, ensuring compliance with performance, manufacturability, and quality requirements. Review and validate engineering calculations related to loads, stresses, dimensions, and material selection. Provide technical leadership and hands-on support during project execution, resolving complex design and site-related technical issues. Act as the primary technical reference for investigating and resolving client technical complaints. Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including design optimization and cost-reduction opportunities. Review tender documents and lead the preparation of technical submissions and clarifications. Coordinate closely with Operations, Projects, Business Development, and Supply Chain to ensure technical alignment across departments. Ensure all technical deliverables comply with internal standards, contractual requirements, and applicable codes. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 10+ years of proven experience in a technical office or mechanical design environment, with demonstrated leadership responsibility. A Master of Engineering (M.Eng.), MSc in Engineering, or MBA is considered an advantage. Proficiency in SolidWorks and AutoCAD is required; familiarity with Fusion 360 and other design software is an advantage. Strong command of Microsoft 365 applications. Very good command of both English and Arabic. Proficiency in working with AI tools is mandatory. Demonstrated ability to solve technical problems independently through research, initiative, and critical thinking. What We Offer: We are proud that we are an equal opportunity employer. Opportunity to grow with an expanding leading steel manufacturing company in Egypt. Ongoing training and development opportunities. Attractive package, compensation, and benefits. Commitment to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where employees feel valued. Promoting a supportive work environment where employees are heard and empowered to succeed. Commitment to sustainable practices and encouraging employees to contribute to environmental responsibility. If you match the above criteria, are interested, and ready to grow with us, we would like to hear from you. Kindly send your CV to careers@elbattat.com , mentioning: “Application for Technical Office Manager - [Your Full Name]” in the subject line.
